title: [review] project-LICHEN-6mij: keys_single_delete uses LICHEN_COAP_SERVER_MAX_PAYLOAD plain buffer for method that has no payload
description: keys_single_delete at coap_keys.c:1086 allocates `uint8_t plain[LICHEN_COAP_SERVER_MAX_PAYLOAD]` for authorize_mutating, but DELETE requests have no payload. The old code used 16 bytes. This wastes stack (~1KB). Fix: use a small buffer (16-32 bytes) or a shared minimal buffer for zero-payload methods.
